title: Recipe 46 — Tokenized access & DID-gated entitlements (rules, resolved at boot)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Token-gating is not a new permission kind. It's ordinary permission rules, resolved from a wallet at boot.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Type the recipe's boot wiring
beats.cue: “resolveTokenGatedRules runs once, at boot, and hands the gateway a plain rule list. After that nothing knows about tokens.”

beats.label: Prove it parses
beats.cue: “The recipe's fence is a real file — TypeScript you can drop into your own boot path.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const s = require("fs").readFileSync("live/entitlements.ts","utf8"); new Bun.Transpiler({ loader: "ts" }).transformSync(s); console.log("live/entitlements.ts: parses as TypeScript");'

verify.note: the recipe's boot-wiring fence is syntactically valid TS

beats.label: Open it
beats.cue: “Note what it returns: rules. Not a middleware, not a hook — the same shape a human would have typed into the spec.”

groups.title: Beat 2 · the rules it produces are ordinary rules

beats.label: Open a committed rule set
beats.cue: “This is what resolveTokenGatedRules is producing at runtime — procode's hand-written tiers, same schema.”

beats.label: Type a harness with a rule set
beats.cue: “Any shape with permissions can be token-gated. Nothing about the spec changes.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean — the entitlement resolution is boot-time wiring, invisible to the compiler.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN. The gateway that will receive those resolved rules is real, emitted code.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the declared credentials gate

beats.label: Open the gateway
beats.cue: “One rule-evaluation path. A token holder and a hard-coded allowlist take exactly the same code path.”

beats.label: Boot with no chain access
beats.cue: “If the entitlement can't be resolved, the answer is no access — never a default-open fallback.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/daemon.ts > live/failclosed.log 2>&1

verify.note: refuses at the first missing gate rather than starting with an empty rule set

beats.label: Read the refusal
beats.cue: “An unresolvable entitlement is a startup failure. That is the safe direction to fail in.”

beats.label: Read the DID variants
beats.cue: “Same mechanism with a verifiable credential instead of a token balance — the rule list doesn't care which.”
